events.description: Spun out of full-sweep audit on 2026-05-19 (C10 critical). All three cultures need Hall / Barracks / Archery Range renames + train-list restriction; current code is culture-agnostic except for two TechTree IDs.

Phase 1 partial: created Core/Settings/CulturedBuildingNames.cs with static GetDisplayName(baseBuildingId, culture) lookup covering Hall/Barracks/ArcheryRange/Hut for all three cultures. Wiring into BuildingPrefabSwapSystem (stamp at age-up), EntityExtractors (selection header), and HudBridge (web HUD selection card) deferred to a follow-up pass. Helper is callable from anywhere.

Phases 2-3 deferred. Phase 2 (train-list culture filter) touches BuildingFactory + TrainingSystem + BuildCommandPannel + EntityExtractors and needs design alignment with task-079 (Age-1 unit tier ladders). Phase 3 (culture-keyed upgrade costs) may turn out to be a no-op if doc 4.3 costs are uniform across cultures; needs a closer read of Complete.md before adding the per-culture switch to BuildingUpgradeConfig.
